verdict.rationale: Cekura publishes an API reference with concrete endpoints, including ingesting call logs via POST (send-calls) and creating project-level API keys. A probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at docs.cekura.ai/openapi.json, and the API is also wrapped by an official SDK (sync/async clients) and a CLI for managing agents, scenarios, runs, and call data. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving workflows end-to-end via the API, and evidence showing the API reference covers every product surface (only a few endpoints are directly cited).
